RSS Feed Google News Macro, commodities and supply chains A Supply Crisis Is Brewing in the Metals That Power Everything (ALM) remains a central theme as shortages in battery‑ and semiconductor‑grade metals threaten capex for EVs and data centers. Tight upstream capacity can raise input costs and compress manufacturers' margins, while boosting the strategic value of miners and recyclers — a backdrop that shapes capital allocation for hardware and clean‑tech names. Read the coverage. Kinross (KGC) reported strong first‑quarter 2026 results, a positive read for gold producers as prices and operational execution support free cash flow. See the release. Alamos Gold (AGI) posted Q1 results, reinforcing the narrative that senior gold miners can provide cash‑flow resilience when metals markets flicker. Read the report. Suzano (SUZ) sold a record 12.7 million tonnes of pulp for the first time in its history, a landmark for paper‑ and pulp‑cycle dynamics that can pressure prices and influence forestry capex and export flows. See the note. Big tech earnings and market outlook Microsoft (MSFT) posted its earnings press release to the investor site; traders will watch cloud growth, AI licensing cadence and guidance for implications across software and AI‑infrastructure suppliers. Read the press release. Meta (META) reported first‑quarter 2026 results today; investors will parse ad‑revenue trends and AI monetization cadence as management updates its growth strategy. See the earnings release. Amazon.com (AMZN) also posted Q1 results, with focus on AWS margins, retail unit economics and Prime monetization — all key to the company's market outlook. Read the release. Qualcomm (QCOM) made its earnings release available, a read for 5G chipset demand signals and handset guidance into the next cycle. See the update. Equinix (EQIX) reported first‑quarter results and raised its full‑year financial outlook, underscoring resilient data‑center demand and pricing power tied to AI and cloud growth. Read the statement. Insurance, financials and capital markets Allstate (ALL) reported strong earnings and an increased growth outlook, a notable positive for P&C insurers as underwriting trends and investment income both shape return on equity and dividend capacity. Read the release. Axis Capital (AXS) reported first‑quarter net income available to common shareholders of $247 million and operating income of $257 million, a solid result for reinsurers and specialty insurers navigating catastrophe and premium‑rate dynamics. Read the release. Redwood Trust (RWT) reported first‑quarter results and said mortgage banking production hit a record $8.5 billion, a notable datapoint for mortgage‑finance players and spread exposure. See the statement. First Mid (FMBH) named Matt Smith CEO and president while Joe Dively transitions to executive chairman, a planned succession that investors often see as stabilizing for regional‑bank strategy and capital deployment. Read the announcement. Transportation, shipping and energy Ford (F) posted first‑quarter 2026 financials, with market attention on EV unit ramp, margin mix and capex plans as the automaker balances legacy ICE cash flow with EV investments. Read the release. SEACOR Marine (SMHI) announced first‑quarter 2026 results, a read relevant for offshore‑support and marine logistics demand as energy and shipping flows shift. See the report. Carrier (CARR) Ventures boosted backing of ZutaCore to scale liquid cooling for AI data centers, addressing thermal constraints that matter as chip densities rise. See the note. Methanex (MEOH) reported first‑quarter results and said it is well‑positioned in the current environment, a signal for methanol markets and chemical‑feedstock exposure in commodity cycles. Read the release. AI infrastructure, datacenters and satellites Gorilla Technology (GRRR) and Yotta expanded an India AI infrastructure program valued at roughly US$2.8 billion, underscoring multi‑year demand for hyperscale and edge compute. Read the announcement.
